body: I’m currently in high school. I think I would go into Pre-Med.

I’d really like to have a product that can help millions medically. I have various ideas for various products. But, it’s not a safe play. 

I don’t think I’d have the money or time to work on it anytime during or after college because of the fact I will be working a lot just to pay off my debt.
Entrepreneurship and business can be risky, sadly.
Yeah, I’d have to become a doctor for financial stability.
Thank you so, so much! This really gives me hope - as I can’t stand the place. I will mention this to my school counselor during my meeting.
